title: Visual catalog card
responsibility: Shows page or component screenshots and facts with a shared linked consumer footer.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.row
inputs.description: Facts for one page or visual component: its name, purpose, usages, contained components, changed flag and verification.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.shot
inputs.description: A usable screenshot or null. Includes its original captured commit and whether the shown revision reuses validated unchanged evidence. Missing media or image-load failure shows an explicit gap.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.nav
inputs.description: The selected branch, commit and navigation actions; opening the card keeps that scope.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.category
inputs.description: Pages keep their title and screenshot, plus the same shared usage footer. Components also show purpose, contained components and verification.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.verification
inputs.description: Defaults to true in catalogs; false in relationship tabs to omit verification indicators.

inputs.name: ExplorerPageCard.lens
inputs.description: Revision-scoped screenshot evidence for linked consumers.

outputs.name: ExplorerPageCard
outputs.description: Catalog item using the shared Used In consumer links and screenshot previews, with navigation and captures bound to the selected revision. Other item facts and verification follow the category.
